sources.role: Working cartridge-reader implementation explicitly identifies a 24-position 2.54 mm pitch connector
Independent firsthand cartridge-reader BOM specifies two rows, 24 contacts and 2.54 mm pitch
Author's working cartridge PCB was tested in an original Starmaster case; provides a demonstrated compatible mating interface, not an original Atari PCB drawing
Atari:2600_Cartridge_Port footprint has 1.524 x 6.35 mm fingers at 2.54 mm pitch; mating tab Edge.Cuts span 136.398 to 168.910 mm, width 32.512 mm; measurements only, no traces or game data copied
Firsthand original Heavy Sixer board and enclosure photographs; retained outer guide and two-board construction
Manufacturer standard DE-9 contact pitch 2.77 mm and row spacing 2.84 mm; Atari plastic housings retain photo-derived dimensions.

remaining_estimates: 33.2 mm insertion opening is a study clearance around the compatible board tab, not an original Atari tolerance.
Socket exterior, tilt, spring form and termination depths remain photographic study dimensions.
Blank cartridge enclosure and main PCB are original study geometry; only the mating tab and contact array use compatible-board measurements.
No original housing dimensional drawing, complete dust-door mechanism or functional circuit is verified.

legacy_repairs.scope: Strict saved-native audit detected old C0 sweep surfaces and touching glyph boundaries. Springs use the existing split-helix helper at unchanged radius/pitch/placement; RF cable retains endpoints and uses an approximate analytic storage route; text solids are unioned.

changes: Rear D-shaped sockets and contact rows corrected from wide-bottom/five-lower to wide-top/five-upper.
Raised rear surrounds reduced from 34 x 18 mm to 24 x 14 mm; housings to 20.8 x 10.5 mm with fitted D-shaped case apertures.
Both CX10 female noses and paddle female nose match the corrected keying, while preserving the original six used contacts.
Existing Fuji mark redrawn with smooth curves and aligned above the existing wordmark.
Inner sealing flanges mask the housing clearance without exposing boards or wires.
exterior_review.basis: Local outline dimensions and mark proportions are photograph fits, scaled against the existing approximate body envelope; not factory dimensions.
